1. 空き地に道路を延ばし、道路に隣接する住宅・商業・工業地区を配置します。\n:
1. Build roads on clear land and place residential, commercial and industrial zones next to them.
2. Build a power plant and connect zones with power lines. Use the power display to check zone centers.
3. Press Play. The engine develops the city according to demand, traffic, power and taxes.
4. Adjust taxes and funding in Budget, then save from the File menu.

Right-drag or scroll with two fingers to pan. Pinch, use the mouse wheel, or Command-scroll to zoom. Fit resets the view.
